$comment: Dated console-warning allowlist (W-D030). Every entry needs a regex, a reason, who added it and an expiry (YYYY-MM-DD); expired entries stop matching. Errors are never allowlisted.

allow.reason: ANGLE's D3D11 HLSL compiler note on three r186's PMREMGGXConvolution program ('THREE.WebGLProgram: Program Info Log: (210,81-129): warning X4122: sum of 0.996094 and -2.98545e-017 cannot be represented accurately in double precision'). The program links and runs; three echoes the program log as a console warning (#54 item 3, from W-S1).
